about.text: A small Corsican cheese of raw ewe's milk, about 10 to 12 cm across and 500 to 700 g, created in the 1950s and made at Furiani in Haute-Corse. Its rind is dusted with herbs such as rosemary, savory, fennel, chili and juniper, and it ripens for one to three months, becoming firmer and more granular.

sources.text: Its milk, size, herbs, ripening and trademark, from these.
